name: Fianna
personality: A quiet priestess who likes poetry, spicy food, coffee, and people she can trust.
story: Found unconscious by a riverside years ago, she was taken in by the temples and later joined Vandahl Trading. She bears the Crest of Fraldarius, and her mysterious origins hint at a hidden past. Recruitment costs 3000G plus Support 3.

personalSkill.name: Graceful Light
personalSkill.effect: When healing an ally with magic, reduces magic cost to 0. Trigger % = Lck. Lv 20+: Gift of Faith adds +20/+30 HP to heals. Crest of Fraldarius: restores minor HP on attack, 20% trigger.

tierNotes: KeenGamer: B tier (highest Mag growth among recruits, but 25% Lck limits free heals). Pocket Tactics: B tier.

why: Bench recruit on Leda's route: join her in Ch 7 at about Lv 15 (Beginner), as soon as Renown 5 and Support 3 land.
Olympia and Catania heal the Part I maps; she heals dungeon parties and trains for Part II.
recruit.tip: 3,000G. Gift her, then seat her at Leda's Sunday meals from Ch 4 so Support 3 is there in Ch 7.

build.notes: Bench in Part I. She joins in Ch 7 at about Lv 15, heals dungeon parties for EXP and takes Priest at Lv 20 with White C. Arena Mage builds White B by 11/27; Bishop from Part II Ch 2 at Lv 35, Wiseman at Lv 45 in Part III.

guide.summary: The army's fourth healer, built for Part II. She joins in Ch 7, heals dungeon parties through Part I, and heals from the second row from Part II Ch 1; [[class:Bishop]] doubles her casts from Ch 2. Graceful Light and [[ability:Gift of Faith+]] both roll on Lck, so feed her Lck and keep her behind the tanks.
guide.playstyle: Heal every turn from behind the tanks, next to Sha Lan (Spd +4) or a tank (Barrier). Attack only with Seraphim on undead.
keys: Recruit her in Ch 7: Support 3, Renown 5, 3,000G. She joins at about Lv 15

Diviner to Lv 20, then [[class:Priest]] (White C) in Ch 8 or 9
EXP: the healer seat in every dungeon party; aim at Lv 30? by Ch 12
Hold a Healing Staff and 2 Concoctions at 11/27: only held items reach Part II
Bishop in Part II Ch 2 (Lv 35, White B); Wiseman at Lv 45 in Part III
watch: Lck: Graceful Light and Gift of Faith+ fire at Lck %. Piety +3 and Bishop's Lck +20 growth feed both
Def: Bishop grows Def −10. Two hits from a Part II striker kill her
White B: Mage course weekly from Ch 7 plus Priest's White +2; check it in Ch 11
Weight: Healing Staff 3, nothing else worn; Photona's Holy Staff 5 on wide maps. Bishop's Thunder (7) and Bolganone (8) only on spare turns
No Physic: Olympia and Catania cover the range heals on the Part II Ch 3 hold
